newsitem.title: USA: Mexico may have bought 40,000 T US soybeans -trade.
newsitem.headline: Mexico may have bought 40,000 T US soybeans -trade.

text.p: Several U.S. exporters said Mexico may have bought 40,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 soybeans late last week.
On Monday, there was widespread talk among soybean traders on the Chicago Board of Trade that Mexico did the purchase.
"The shipment was for scattered October. The soybeans were shipped via rail, Laredo, Texas," one U.S. exporter said. "They bought it Thursday," he added, giving no other details.
Another U.S. soybean exporter said the quantity and October position were feasible but he had no confirmation.
"Theoretically, it's possible, but I just do not know about it," a third exporter said.
